description: This file is a PHP script for handling survey display and submission in SuiteCRM, including validation, fetching survey data, rendering survey questions, and managing survey state (open/closed). It also includes HTML and JavaScript for the survey frontend.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: Template rendering class used for displaying the closed survey page.

methods.name: getSurveyLinkTracker
methods.description: Fetches the survey link tracker ID from the database based on the tracker ID.

methods.name: displaySurvey
methods.description: Renders the survey form with questions and submit button.

methods.name: displayQuestion
methods.description: Displays individual survey questions based on their type.

methods.name: displayRadioField
methods.description: Displays a radio button question with options.

methods.name: displayRadioButton
methods.description: Displays a single radio button option.

methods.name: displayMatrixField
methods.description: Displays a matrix question with multiple options.

methods.name: displayDateTimeField
methods.description: Displays a date and time picker question.

methods.name: displayClosedPage
methods.description: Displays a page indicating the survey is closed.
